checked_items.item: Creepage requirement 5.0 mm sink-to-tab/HV copper (500 V, PD2, material group IIIa, IEC 60664-1 Table F.5 'from memory')
checked_items.evidence: Standard text not accessible. Secondary sources: Analog Devices article reproduces IEC 60950 Table 2N (derived from IEC 60664-1): 400 V basic PD2 I/II/III = 2.0/2.8/4.0 mm, PD3 = 5.0/5.6/6.3 mm, reinforced 400 V PD2 III = 8.0 mm (no 500 V row shown); this row pattern matches IEC 60664-1 Table F.4/F.5, whose next row (500 V, PD2, III) is 5.0 mm. A conflicting reproduction (tamhash.co.il catalogue table, 'Values taken from IEC 60664-1, but maintaining a minimum value of 1.5 mm', IEC 60947-1/61439-1 style) gives PD2 IIIa/IIIb: 400 V 5.0 mm, 500 V 6.3 mm, 630 V 8.0 mm - one row higher because that family assigns the next-higher voltage row.
checked_items.correction: 5.0 mm is plausible as the IEC 60664-1 basic-insulation creepage at 500 V/PD2/IIIa but could not be confirmed from the standard; if the isolation review applies an IEC 60947-1/61439-1-derived table the value is 6.3 mm at Ui 500 V, and reinforced insulation would require 10 mm. The 5.5 mm pad overhang then no longer suffices; make the pad size conditional on the review.

knowledge_misuse: No TI instance values were copied as design values: the agent used 50 degC ambient, 0.68 K/W sink, 0.80 K/W pad and its own losses instead of TI's 40 degC, 0.5 degC/W, 0.1 degC/W and 50/69 W (SKILL-006 lines 25, 42-43; EC-019/020).

KR-CAP-003 is cited as the source of a '>= 125 degC' ceramic rating; the record is a placement rule (bulk film + distributed HV ceramics beside the bridge) with no temperature content - attribution error, not a value copy.

KR-TH-003 says 'isolate NTC feedback'; the agent offers a 'direct ADC if control ground is PE-bonded' option without recording it as a deviation, and its divider-based readout ignores the CB-PR-002 AIN/APWM route that gate_driver.json has already adopted.

The proposed SKILL-006 caveat ('CR201-50VE 0.5 degC/W not supported by the datasheet') overstates the case: the Ohmite sheet contains a forced-convection chart (0.25-2.75 degC/W vs 0-1200 ft/min, two TO-247 sources, 10 W) from which 0.5 degC/W is a plausible reading; the genuine gaps are the unstated airflow, the 10 W test power and the series' discontinuation.
CB-PR-002 and KR-TH-003 prescribe calibration with a potentiometer; the agent wrote 'fixed resistor' (minor).
required_changes: Re-baseline the interface resistance on the exposed-metal area of the TO-247-4L outline (D1 x E1 = 16.25-17.65 x 13.1-14.15 mm, about 2.3 cm2 / 0.36 in2, to be confirmed on the drawing): R_pad TSP 3500 about 1.20 K/W (clip, 25 psi) / 0.92 K/W (screw, 50 psi); update T_J (about 134 degC typ / 144 degC max-R on 0.68 K/W), P_max (33.7 W at 150 degC, 25.3 W at 125 degC) and the statement that the 125 degC preference is met; since this crosses the agent's own 1 K/W trigger, decide now between screw mounting, the LAM 5 D K 100 12 sink or a lower-impedance interface.

Remove Ohmite CR201-50VE and CLA-TO-21E as alternatives: the Ohmite datasheet states 'DISCONTINUED since August 2024'. Correct the 'no forced-air data' statement (a forced-convection chart exists) and soften the SKILL-006 caveat accordingly.

Replace Boyd 7721-7PPSG in the screw-mount alternative: its 0.81 mm shoulder does not cover the 2.23-2.54 mm TO-247 hole depth, leaving 0.4-0.55 mm of air between the screw and the drain-potential hole wall. Specify a TO-247 insulating bushing with >= 2.5 mm shoulder rated for the working voltage, or delete the screw alternative; the 0.56-0.68 N m torque is unverified.

Update the NTC record to Vishay document 29092 Rev 14-Jan-2026: -55 to +150 degC, dissipation factor 13 mW/K (self-heating 0.06 K), thermal time constant 5 s, response time 4 s, 400 mW max at 55 degC; keep part number NTCALUG01A103F (3984 K), not the 3435 K 'FL' variant.

Reconcile the NTC readout with gate_driver.json (NTC on the LS UCC21710 AIN/APWM): drop the 2.2 kohm / 3.00 V divider, 15.5 mV/K and 21 LSB/K figures or move them to an 'if direct ADC' appendix; re-express the 90/100/110 degC thresholds as AIN voltage / APWM duty (V_AIN = 0.2 mA x R_NTC = 0.18 / 0.14 / 0.10 V), check the AIN input range against a 10 kohm NTC at trip temperatures (a higher R25 or series resistor may be needed), and log any 'direct ADC' path as an explicit KR-TH-003 deviation.

Mark the LAM 5 K 100 12 airflow (14.3-20 m3/h), exhaust velocity (2.6-3.7 m/s) and the '>= 2 m/s seed satisfied' statement as unsupported; the family spread 0.27 K/W (24 V, 20 m3/h) vs 0.68 K/W (12 V) implies much lower flow at 12 V. Obtain the Fischer datasheet (the exact 'LAM 5 K 100 12' string was found at no distributor) before BOM freeze.

Creepage: present 5.0 mm as the IEC 60664-1 Table F.4/F.5 basic-insulation value for 500 V / PD2 / IIIa (consistent with IEC 60950-1 Table 2N as reproduced by ADI) but state that IEC 60947-1/61439-1-derived tables give 6.3 mm at Ui 500 V and that reinforced insulation would need 10 mm; make the pad oversize (currently 5.5 mm overhang) conditional on the isolation review's choice.
Delete or source the '2.5 kV requirement' for the pad breakdown voltage; the type-test voltage is the isolation agent's to define.
State that R_thJC 0.41 K/W is a typical value with no datasheet maximum and that 48.5 / 57.2 mohm at 150 degC are interpolated/scaled, not datasheet values; add an explicit margin or sensitivity.

Minor: re-label the >= 125 degC ceramic requirement as an AIPE recommendation (not KR-CAP-003 content); use 'potentiometer' per CB-PR-002; fix the 12-26 vs 17-26 psi inconsistency; the max-R NTC offset is 42 K; update the Vishay datasheet revision and the Henkel TDS reference (TDS Nov 2018, PDF signed 2025-11-27).
summary: Source fact-check of the thermal area. Verified against primary datasheets: Bergquist TSP 3500 and TSP A2000 (all impedance, breakdown, Dk, temperature and thickness figures match the Nov 2018 TDS), Wakefield ulTIMiFlux (0.003 in, 0.107 degC-in2/W at 100 psi, 9200 V, 60 degC, die-cut sizes), Wolfspeed C4MS025120K Rev. 2 (R_thJC 0.41 K/W typ, R_DS(on) 25/33 mohm at 25 degC, 47 mohm at 175 degC, TO-247-4L), Vishay NTCALUG01A103F identity and 1500 Vac / 100 Mohm isolation, Sunon fan and Boyd washer dimensions (distributor level), TIDA-010054 Decision 9 and all knowledge-record readings; no TI instance value was copied. Arithmetic recomputed throughout and agrees. Contradicted: (1) the Ohmite CR201-50VE/CLA-TO-21E alternative is discontinued since August 2024 and its datasheet does contain a forced-convection chart; (2) the pad contact area (3.37 cm2) is the full body outline, whereas the outline's exposed-metal dimensions give about 2.3 cm2, raising R_pad to about 1.2 K/W and T_J,HS to about 134/144 degC (150 degC still met, 125 degC preference not met, the agent's own 1 K/W switch trigger is crossed); (3) the Boyd 7721-7PPSG shoulder (0.81 mm) cannot insulate the 2.2-2.5 mm deep TO-247 hole; (4) several NTC parameters are from a superseded revision (current: -55 to +150 degC, 13 mW/K, 5 s) and the divider readout conflicts with the gate-driver agent's UCC21710 AIN/APWM route and with KR-TH-003's 'isolate NTC feedback'. Unverified: every Fischer LAM 5 figure (site blocked, exact part string found at no distributor, airflow of the 12 V unit unknown), AOS 247, Kapton MT+, the 5.0 mm creepage figure (plausible for IEC 60664-1 basic insulation; 6.3 mm under IEC 60947/61439-derived tables; 10 mm if reinforced) and the unexplained '2.5 kV requirement'. Core selection (LAM 5 K 100 12 + Sil-Pad TSP 3500 + NTCALUG01A103F) survives with reduced margin; verdict confirmed-with-corrections.
